title: Seller Performance Standing — Schedule of Performance Limits by Level
content:
Each level of the Seller Performance Standing program sets the performance limits a seller's metrics are held against at the monthly evaluation. The figures below are the limits of each level; a limit shown as not applicable is not set at that level.

## Schedule

| Limit | Below Standard Level | Developing Seller Level | Standard Level | Above Standard Level | Top Rated Level | Preferred Partner Level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Highest order defect rate | not applicable | 0.02 (2%) | 0.02 (2%) | 0.015 (1.5%) | 0.005 (0.5%) | 0.004 (0.4%) |
| Highest count of defective orders below the low-volume threshold | not applicable | 8 | 8 | 6 | 2 | 1 |
| Low-volume order threshold (orders in the defect window) | 400 | 400 | 400 | 400 | 400 | 400 |
| Highest late shipment rate | not applicable | 0.07 (7%) | 0.07 (7%) | 0.05 (5%) | 0.03 (3%) | 0.02 (2%) |
| Highest seller cancellation rate | not applicable | 0.025 (2.5%) | 0.025 (2.5%) | 0.02 (2%) | 0.01 (1%) | 0.005 (0.5%) |
| Lowest valid tracking rate on seller-shipped orders | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0.95 (95%) | 0.98 (98%) | 0.99 (99%) |

## What each limit means

- **Highest order defect rate** — the highest order defect rate (defective orders divided by orders in the defect window, decimal fraction) allowed at the level; not applicable for the fallback level, which is Below Standard Level.
- **Highest count of defective orders at low volume** — when the seller has fewer orders than the low-volume threshold in the defect window, the highest count of defective orders allowed at the level; not applicable for the fallback level.
- **Low-volume order threshold** — the number of orders in the defect window below which the defect count, not the rate, is compared (integer). It is 400 at every level.
- **Highest late shipment rate** — the highest late shipment rate (decimal fraction) allowed at the level; not applicable for the fallback level.
- **Highest seller cancellation rate** — the highest seller cancellation rate (decimal fraction) allowed at the level; not applicable for the fallback level.
- **Lowest valid tracking rate** — the lowest valid tracking rate on seller-shipped orders (decimal fraction) required at the level; not applicable where not required.

## Reading the schedule

**Which comparison applies to the order defect measure?** With 400 or more orders in the defect window the rate is compared with the level's highest order defect rate; with fewer than 400 orders the count of defective orders is compared with the level's highest count. For example (hypothetical figures), a seller with 399 orders in the window is held to a count — at most 6 defective orders at Above Standard Level — while a seller with exactly 400 orders is held to the rate of 0.015.

**Where is valid tracking measured?** Only Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level set a lowest valid tracking rate; the three lower levels set none.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A late shipment rate of 0.04 is within the limit of Above Standard Level (0.05) and of Standard Level (0.07), and above the limit of Top Rated Level (0.03) and Preferred Partner Level (0.02).
